name: @nteract/sift-electron-harness
description: Dev-only Electron harness: Sift's worker path under Kilo Desktop's app scheme, CSP, and ranged IPC reads. Never packaged.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:main
scripts.build:main: vp build --config vite.main.config.ts && HARNESS_ENTRY=preload vp build --config vite.main.config.ts
